title: Large deviations for long-time occupation measures of stochastic evolution equations with small, asymptotically rough noise
summary: We study the long-time, small-noise behavior of a class of dissipative stochastic evolution equations in a separable Hilbert space, driven by a cylindrical Wiener process whose covariance degenerates to a limiting operator in the strong operator topology. A prototypical example is a stochastic reaction-diffusion equation on a bounded domain with spatially homogeneous but spectrally regularized noise that becomes spatially rough in the limit.
